headline: On November 18, 1985: Calvin and Hobbes debuts in ten newspapers
captionCards: First published in ten newspapers on Nov 18, 1985
Endured as a beloved symbol of childhood imagination and satire
instagramCaption:
Calvin and Hobbes hits the newsstands.

The comic strip by Bill Watterson launched on November 18, 1985, appearing in ten newspapers. It follows Calvin, a six-year-old with a wild imagination, and Hobbes, his sentient stuffed tiger. The strip was set in contemporary U.S. and featured recurring characters like Susie Derkins and Miss Wormwood. 

Its blend of humor and philosophical depth made it a cultural touchstone.
